g.text: (accessed by the HAKE code in-process through an injected client function)
QKDKeyPool (in-memory, thread-safe): finite pool depth, lazy refill at refill_bps, 256-bit keys, UUID key_IDs,
single-use retrieval by key_ID, per-peer outstanding-key quota, errors: PoolExhausted / PeerQuotaExceeded
REST API (FastAPI): GET status, GET/POST enc_keys,
GET/POST dec_keys; SAE identity via X-SAE-ID header
QKDClient (HTTP client for the REST API)
implemented, not yet used by the HAKE code
